persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: This is my only product photo. Turn it into three separate square listing images: a clean white-background shot, a lifestyle shot on a gym bench, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish. Keep my exact black bottle, don't add branding or text.
bank.Source product: Use the matte black insulated bottle in product-bottle.jpg as the reference for all three images.
bank.Required views: A clean white-background shot, a gym-bench lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish.
bank.Product changes: Keep the original bottle's shape, proportions, lid design and matte black finish. Do not invent branding.
bank.Photography style: Realistic listing photography; lighting and gym styling are your call.
bank.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.
